zh: 我正在努力少吃糖。
en: I'm trying to {cut back on|cut down on|ease up on|reduce} sugar.

zh: 那次感冒我花了两个星期才好。
en: It took me two weeks to {get over|shake off|recover from|shake|beat} that cold.

zh: 我觉得我快要得流感了。
en: I think I'm {coming down with|getting|catching} the flu.

zh: 他热得晕倒了，我们叫了救护车。
en: He {passed out|fainted|blacked out|collapsed} in the heat and we called an ambulance.

zh: 她昨晚吐了两次。
en: She {threw up|vomited|was sick} twice last night.

zh: 压力大的时候你要照顾好自己。
en: You need to {look after|take care of} yourself when you're stressed.

zh: 我要去躺半个小时。
en: I'm going to {lie down|rest} for half an hour.

zh: 今天早上我醒来时嗓子疼。
en: I {woke up|woke} with a sore throat this morning.

zh: 我爸十年前戒烟了。
en: My dad {gave up|quit|stopped} smoking ten years ago.

zh: 几天后皮疹就消了。
en: The rash {cleared up|went away|disappeared|went|healed|cleared|faded} after a few days.

zh: 止痛药的药效开始消退了。
en: The painkillers are starting to {wear off}.

zh: 我扭伤后脚踝肿了起来。
en: My ankle {swelled up|swelled|puffed up|blew up|ballooned} after I twisted it.

zh: 我肯定是在办公室染上了什么病菌。
en: I must have {picked up|caught|got|gotten} a bug at the office.

zh: 今天早上有两个人打电话请了病假。
en: Two people {called in|rang in|phoned in} sick this morning.

zh: 连续两年周末加班后，她彻底累垮了。
en: She {burned out|burnt out} after two years of working weekends.

zh: 医生叫我放慢节奏，多睡觉。
en: The doctor told me to {slow down|ease up|ease off|relax|rest|take it easy} and get more sleep.

zh: 我这一整个星期都在跟感冒作斗争。
en: I've been {fighting off|fighting|battling} a cold all week.

zh: 医生叫我彻底戒掉奶制品。
en: My doctor told me to {cut out|give up|avoid|drop|quit} dairy completely.

zh: 我的花粉症一到春天就发作。
en: My hay fever always {flares up|plays up|acts up|gets worse|comes back|returns} in spring.

zh: 周六我睡了个懒觉，感觉好多了。
en: I {slept in|slept late|had a lie-in} on Saturday and felt much better.

zh: 如果你生病了，请别来办公室。
en: If you're sick, please {stay away from|keep away from|avoid} the office.

zh: 别去抠伤口上的痂。
en: Don't {pick at|pick|scratch} your scab.

zh: 我正在慢慢停用抗抑郁药。
en: I'm slowly {coming off|getting off|stopping} my antidepressants.

zh: 她最后决定不做那个手术了。
en: In the end she decided not to {go through with|have} the surgery.

zh: 压力常常会引发我的偏头痛。
en: Stress often {brings on|triggers|causes|sets off} my migraines.

zh: 药要分开时间吃，别一次全吃了。
en: {Space out|Spread out} your doses. Don't take them all at once.

zh: 我在候诊室翻了翻杂志。
en: I {flicked through|flipped through|leafed through|skimmed|browsed} a magazine in the waiting room.

zh: 今晚喝这么多，明天你就有罪受了。
en: Drink that much tonight and you'll {pay for} it tomorrow.

zh: 天一冷，我的膝盖就开始不舒服。
en: My knee {acts up|plays up|flares up} when it gets cold.

zh: 我觉得我快要感冒了。
en: I think I've got a cold {coming on}.

zh: 我撞到头之后昏过去了几秒钟。
en: I {blacked out|passed out|fainted} for a few seconds after hitting my head.

zh: 把舌头伸出来，说“啊”。
en: {Stick out|Put out} your tongue and say "ah".

zh: 医生排除了骨折的可能。
en: The doctor {ruled out} a fracture.

zh: 她在心理咨询师的帮助下慢慢走出悲伤。
en: She's {working through|dealing with|processing} her grief with a counsellor.

zh: 我觉得坚持节食很难。
en: I find it hard to {stick to|keep to} a diet.

zh: 他吃什么吐什么。
en: He couldn't {keep down} anything he ate.

zh: 他喝了很多水，想让自己醒醒酒。
en: He drank lots of water to try to {sober up}.

zh: 睡眠不足会导致各种健康问题。
en: Lack of sleep can {lead to|cause|result in} all sorts of health problems.

zh: 她挺过了手术，状况良好。
en: She {came through|got through|pulled through} the surgery well.

zh: 他从自行车上摔下来，把手腕摔断了。
en: He {fell off|came off} his bike and broke his wrist.

zh: 我吃了大虾以后起了一身疹子。
en: I {broke out} in a rash after eating prawns.

zh: 感冒了就待在家，免得传染给同事。
en: Stay home so you don't {pass on|spread} your cold to your colleagues.

zh: 我的头痛终于好了。
en: My headache finally {went away|went|cleared up|stopped|disappeared}.

zh: 牙医昨天给我拔了一颗智齿。
en: The dentist {pulled out|took out|extracted|removed} one of my wisdom teeth yesterday.

zh: 我们还在等检查结果。
en: We're still {waiting on|waiting for} the test results.

zh: 我咬苹果的时候一颗牙掉了。
en: One of my teeth {fell out|came out} when I bit into an apple.

zh: 圣诞节期间我胖了三公斤。
en: I've {put on|gained} three kilos over Christmas.

zh: 她手术后恢复得很快。
en: She {bounced back|recovered|picked up} quickly after the operation.

zh: 办公室一半的人都得了流感。
en: Half the office has {gone down with|come down with|caught|got} the flu.

zh: 止痛药大概二十分钟后起效。
en: The painkillers should {kick in|work|take effect} in about twenty minutes.

zh: 他醒过来的时候已经在医院里了。
en: When he {came to|came round|came around|woke up}, he was in hospital.

zh: 班上一半的孩子都得了水痘。
en: Half the class has {come down with|caught|got|gone down with} chickenpox.

zh: 我可以预约打流感疫苗吗？
en: Can I {book in} for a flu jab?

zh: 摔那一跤磕掉了他两颗门牙。
en: The fall {knocked out} two of his front teeth.

zh: 手术很危险，但他挺过来了。
en: The surgery was risky, but he {pulled through|survived|made it}.

zh: 医生叫我少喝点咖啡。
en: The doctor told me to {lay off|cut down on|cut back on|go easy on} the coffee.
